node.title: Erroneous message from root
node.author: shmem
node.doctext:
Got two messages from [id://113] in my Inbox:

  • [id://113] says You've got a reply to [id://1192269] from [id://830549] at [id://1192277]
  • [id://113] says You've got a reply to [id://1192269] from [id://210889] at [id://1192279]

*Click*... wait, what? [id://210889] didn't reply to my node, but to a node from [id://1069339] - [id://1192272] that is.

Has the [id://1192279|node] from [id://210889] been reparented after the fact? Or is there a bug lurking somewhere in the code, or is there (shudder) a database inconsistency? Did anybody else experience such erroneous messages?

I'm keeping these messages in my Inbox meanwhile.

perl -le'print map{pack c,($-++?1:13)+ord}split//,ESEL'
